## Closed — completion-verifier attestation certified

```
rebar transition d26a-8ffa-97cd-4b2a in_progress closed \
  --class plan_defect --ref 83edf9972728ae1e0729a39098ec70e4fab4617a
  -> transitioned d26a-8ffa-97cd-4b2a: in_progress -> closed; unblocked: none   (exit 0)

rebar verify-signature d26a-8ffa-97cd-4b2a --kind completion-verifier
  -> SIGNATURE[completion-verifier]: certified — ssh-keygen -Y verify accepted
     signature for principal 'b8a354e0-12c3-4cf2-bbf1-fcc9685d5126'
```

Attestation manifest carries `completion-verifier: PASS` and
`verified-at-sha:83edf9972728ae1e0729a39098ec70e4fab4617a` — the close verified the pinned
immutable merge SHA, not a moving `origin/main` (bug `rookie-fickle-hydra`).

The close gate also required a current plan-review attestation
(`require_plan_review_for_close = true`); the prior one was `stale-code` because the fix itself
changed both `file_impact` dependencies. A fresh `rebar review-plan --ref 83edf997…` returned
PASS with 0 blocking / 1 advisory and signed at the same pinned SHA, after which
`review-plan --status` reported `certified`. No `--force` and no gate override was used at any
point.
